top_signals.title: Taiwan says it is closely monitoring a series of Chinese live-fire drills
top_signals.summary: The closest drill to Taiwan is off China's eastern province of Zhejiang. The drills are scheduled to last all week, according to notices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
